extracted.name: Campfire Baked Potatoes
extracted.description: These campfire baked potatoes are smeared with butter, wrapped in foil, then cooked in the hot embers until perfectly tender, fluffy, and delicious!
instruction_lines: Poke each potato several times all over with a fork. Smear each potato with 1 tablespoon of butter, then double wrap in aluminum foil.
Bury potatoes in the hot coals of a campfire and cook until crispy on the outside and tender inside, about 30 to 60 minutes.
